decisive_items: diffuse tenderness with rebound tenderness, primarily in the right abdomen
Ascites culture yielded growth of Escherichia coli

Showed edema in all layers of intestinal wall, predominant thickening and edema in submucosa, diffuse infiltration of neutrophils with presence of abscesses. Bacterial colonies observed in submucosa surrounding the ESD lesion.
response.rationale: ESD术后出现腹膜炎体征，腹水培养阳性，组织学显示肠壁感染和脓肿，符合术后腹膜炎；感染性结肠炎为局部，但腹膜炎更特异。

rejected.why: 症状和体征不典型，CT显示升结肠病变而非阑尾
无全身器官功能障碍证据，脓毒症诊断过宽
病变位于升结肠而非盲肠，且无中性粒细胞减少背景
中性粒细胞绝对值不低，不符合中性粒细胞减少性结肠炎
无憩室证据，病变部位不符
